external_collaboration.evidence_quote: In the last week of August, the Faculty of Environmental Protection hosted, in the framework of the Erasmus+ mobility training programme, assoc. prof. dr. Aniela Pop and prof. univ. dr. ing, Florica Manea from the partner Faculty of Industrial Chemistry and Environmental Engineering, Politechnica University Timisoara, Romania. The visit was part of a short training course to exchange knowledge and experience in the field of environmental protection.

Na Fakulteti za varstvo okolja od 11. avgusta do 5. septembra v okviru mednarodnega programa mobilnosti Erasmus+ gostimo študenta partnerske Univerze Transilvanija iz Brašova. Študent dodiplomskega študijskega programa na Fakulteti za oblikovanje izdelkov in okolje (Faculty of Product Design and Environment), Gheorghe-Adrian Boricean, bo na FVO opravljal praktično usposabljanje na temo Spremljanje, odkrivanje in analiza mikroplastike v okolju.
